purpose: Correct static image measurement after a real screenshot showed a partial opacity entrance animation
targets: The same sixteen unchanged generated artifacts and anonymous mapping, both versions and all three viewports
operations: Same revision-three checks and read-only bounded waits; no model generation or app source edits
static_capture: Wait finite browser animations at most five seconds and stable scroll position at most two seconds; Playwright animations=disabled for static screenshots
reason: DOM state and URL can match while entrance opacity/transform or smooth scrolling is incomplete; those frames cannot establish the final visual appearance
ratings: One independent A/B rating per case/trial, eight calls, same rubric and 180-second cap; no retry of timeouts
budget: Shared original 240-minute total; run only after the concurrent local recovery releases its reservation
records: Write revision four operations-stable/screens-stable and ratings-stable; retain all previous operations, images and ratings
limits: Static appearance only, not animation quality or human usability; timing-corrected ratings are supplementary measurements, not additional independent generation trials
